title: PlayerMutations catalog
description: Foods that feed the mutation diet, consumables that trigger mutation actions, and decontamination effects. Every section is keyed by form.
x-help:
Tales ports the 19 Fallout 76 player mutations. This catalog tells it which items and effects take part.

Foods: Carnivore and Herbivore depend on what the player eats. Mark each food as meat or vegetable.

Consumables: an item that, when used, triggers a mutation action: starting or stopping Starched Genes, curing a random mutation, or the Rad-X effects. Pick the action that matches what the item should do.

Decontamination: magic effects that count as decontamination and can remove a random mutation (unless Starched Genes protects the player).
